source/core/MABE.hpp mabe::MABE::Setup (Setup_CommandLine -> Setup_Modules -> Setup_Traits -> UpdateSignals -> SetupBase; command-line flags --filename/-f, --batch/-b, --generate/-g, --set/-s, --help/-h, --version/-v)

source/core/MABE.hpp mabe::MABE::Update (fires config_script START on update 0, then per update: before_update signal, ++update, on_update signal, config_script UPDATE event, until target reached or exit_now)

source/core/MABEBase.hpp mabe::MABEBase (owns the 16 module signals before_update/on_update/before_repro/on_offspring_ready/on_inject_ready/before_placement/on_placement/before_mutate/on_mutate/before_death/before_swap/on_swap/before_pop_resize/on_pop_resize/before_exit/on_help and AddOrgAt/ClearOrgAt/SwapOrgs/ResizePop primitives)
source/select/SelectTournament.hpp mabe::SelectTournament::Select (for num_births rounds pick tourny_size random occupied orgs, keep max of fit_equation, control.Replicate best into birth_pop)
source/orgs/BitsOrg.hpp mabe::BitsOrg::Mutate (draw num_muts from shared mut_dist, toggle that many distinct random bit positions)
source/evaluate/static/EvalNK.hpp mabe::EvalNK::EvaluateCollection (scores bits_trait on an N,K landscape into fitness_trait)
source/Emplode/Emplode.hpp emplode::Emplode (lexer/parser/AST/symbol-table interpreter for the .mabe scripting language that wires modules and @START/@UPDATE events)
example_command: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN (README gives no run command; build/Makefile 'make' in build/ produces ./MABE, and runs/GPTP2022/run.sh invokes ../../build/MABE with -f <file>.mabe style config; source/core/MABE.hpp registers '--filename -f [filename...]')
example_input: An Emplode script such as settings/NK.mabe: declares Population main_pop/next_pop, BitsOrg bits_org {N=num_bits; mut_prob=0.01}, EvalNK eval_nk {N; K=3; bits_trait='bits'; fitness_trait='fitness'}, SelectElite and SelectTournament modules, DataFile columns, then @START() { main_pop.INJECT('bits_org', pop_size) } and @UPDATE(Var ud) { IF (ud == max_ud) EXIT(); eval_nk.EVAL(main_pop); ... elite.SELECT(main_pop, next_pop, 25); tournament.SELECT(main_pop, next_pop, num_tournaments); main_pop.REPLACE_WITH(next_pop); }
example_output: Per-update PRINT line with UD, MainPopSize, AveFitness, MaxFitness, ModeFitness and mode-relative counts to stdout, plus DataFile CSVs fitness.csv (Average/Maximum/Dominant Fitness) and max_org.csv (best Fitness and Genome) per settings/NK.mabe; tests/regression holds expected .csv/.txt outputs

built_to: A software framework 'deigned to easily build and customize software for evolutionary computation or artificial life', with resulting systems 'useful for studying evolutionary dynamics, solving complex problems, comparing evolving systems, or exploring the open-ended power of evolution' (README).
pressure: README: MABE 2.0 'is being re-built from scratch, using the Empirical library' with the goal 'to allow for more modular control, flexible agents, faster run times and portability to the web' relative to version 1; TODO lists genomes/brains interface, web interface and evaluation-system fixes as open projects.
success_means: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN (README states goals -- modularity, flexibility, speed, web portability -- but no metric; CI success is passing unit and regression tests under tests/, and runs/ hold GPTP2022/GPTP2024 experiment scripts that record fitness CSVs)
main_loop_one_sentence: MABE::Update triggers the script's START event on the first call and then, for each update until the target count or an EXIT(), rescans module signals if needed, fires before_update, increments the update counter, fires on_update, and triggers the script's @UPDATE(ud) block, which in the shipped .mabe settings evaluates the population with an Eval module, writes data files, calls Select modules that Replicate chosen parents (with Organism::Mutate applied on reproduction) into next_pop, and replaces main_pop with next_pop.
behavioral_entry_point: settings/*.mabe @UPDATE block (Emplode script chooses Eval/Select/placement modules and their parameters without recompiling); in C++: source/select/*.hpp Select(...) methods, source/orgs/*.hpp Mutate(...), and source/core/MABE.hpp MABE::Update / MABEBase signal set for lifecycle hooks
